request.text: Set a reminder for October 12, 2026 at 7:30 PM Pacific: watch the season finale of Harbor Lights. Don't change it to 7:30 UTC.

responsibilities.outcome: Create the requested entertainment reminder at the exact local date, time, and timezone with the supplied reminder subject.

bindings.reminder_text: Watch the season finale of Harbor Lights

semantic_facts: The reminder must retain October 12, 2026 at 7:30 PM in the America/Los_Angeles timezone and the Harbor Lights season-finale subject.
The explicit UTC warning constrains interpretation: 7:30 PM must not be treated as 7:30 PM UTC.
forbidden_claims: A reminder is planned for 7:30 PM UTC or another date, time, or timezone.
The assistant claims the reminder was created before trusted capability completion evidence exists.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A timezone-bearing reminder is grounded as a superficially matching UTC clock time.
A capability plan drops the entertainment subject or invents completion evidence.
